items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: So another fellow they called Tony, he had to play style there, you see, or he had to be able to afterwards, you see. He tried to get us to come down and play where we was working there, you see.

ctx.x: Grand Iowa, old Grand Iowa. Faced right on the Gulf, you know what I mean? Yeah. Well we played for him, and we played quite a while for him, and then after that we left from there we'd start playing for this other fellow. So we played every Saturday and Sunday. So until after, well, things began to get boom, after they started to build the road. See after they built the road, well people, a lot of different traffic going there you see.
